Use Cases

## How leading industrial companies scale campaigns

CONTENT REPURPOSING

## Create marketing content from your technical documents

Tap into your existing technical knowledge from white papers, research reports, and more. [Web Agent](https://www.typeface.ai/product/web-agent) transforms these into SEO-optimized blogs, press releases, and webpages — all with citations and technical accuracy.

**Real-world impact**

A Fortune 500 energy provider drove 65% higher engagement by repurposing long-form technical content into SEO blogs and social posts with Typeface.

![Content Repurposing Industry Page Industrial and Manufacturing](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/66cazWO5M7xUSVbjOw8OL1/e9342fd4f71764bae947a74d3f3f840b/Content_Repurposing_Industry_Page_Industrial_and_Manufacturing.png)

CUSTOM AGENTS

## Automate partner and sales enablement workflows

Typeface [Agent Studio](https://www.typeface.ai/product/agent-studio) lets you build custom AI agents for your unique industrial workflows. These agents can create sales toolkits and partner assets, using actions you choose like web search and bulk content generation.

**Real-world impact**

A Fortune 500 company cut asset creation time from 2 weeks to 5 days by automating creative variations for faster deployment across partner networks.

![Custom Agents Industry Page Industrial and Manufacturing](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/3ioOY6hiWA6QHrlww4YJxb/78a866040cae959cf3a7b09186df685b/Custom_Agents_Industry_Page_Industrial_and_Manufacturing.png)

IMAGE AGENT

## Generate product imagery that matches your brand

Train [Image Agent](https://www.typeface.ai/product/image-agent) on your visual brand standards — lighting, backgrounds, colors, and more. Whether it's data centers, manufacturing equipment, or industrial facilities, create on-brand imagery without expensive photoshoots.

**Real-world impact**

A Fortune 500 electronics brand uses Typeface to create personalized content across 90+ global markets while ensuring brand compliance.

![Image Agent Industry Page Industrial and Manufacturing](https://images.ctfassets.net/x690ow8339ug/1SBWo2RiagQTxHGbfXtqPR/70116589c0187b27405d5ce93182a65d/Image_Agent_Industry_Page_Industrial_and_Manufacturing.png)

GLOBAL MARKET ADAPTATION

## Localize your campaigns for every market

Typeface’s agents adapt your master content for each market — translating technical specifications accurately and adjusting imagery for regional preferences. One product launch becomes dozens of market-ready campaigns.

## Frequently asked questions

* * *

Can Typeface integrate with our existing systems?

Yes. Typeface has a vast [connector library](https://www.typeface.ai/integrations) with native integrations to major DAMs, data platforms, productivity tools and more. You can also connect to your existing systems via API or our [partner ecosystem.](https://www.typeface.ai/partners/ecosystem)

* * *

Can Typeface generate content for different audience expertise levels?

Absolutely. You can specify the target audience for any content — engineers, procurement specialists, C-suite executives, or end users. Typeface ensures that the content is tailored to the chose audience, by adjusting the tone, depth and structure, while also staying on-brand.

* * *

Can distributors and channel partners use Typeface?

Yes. You can add stakeholders to Typeface with role-based access control, ensuring complete data security. You can also create dedicated brand kits that partners can access to generate content within your approved guidelines.
